cases.step_name: Whole flow
cases.title: Signed out while in the flow
cases.question: After signing in again, do they return to where they were?
cases.expected: If the mirrored ATS/Gmail session cookie expires mid-run, pause, prompt human re-auth in visible Chrome, and re-sync cookies.

cases.step_name: Acquires atomic SQLite domain lease
cases.title: The other system returns an error
cases.question: Is the message specific, and is there a retry or another route?
cases.expected: If SQLite WAL is corrupted or read-only, surface a clear diagnostic error instead of bypassing mutual exclusion.

cases.step_name: Mirrors Chrome profile cookies & storage (OS Keychain)
cases.title: No answer in time
cases.question: After how long does it give up, and what can the user do then?
cases.expected: If macOS Keychain modal hangs waiting for user approval, time out after 30s and offer ephemeral profile fallback.

cases.step_name: Mirrors Chrome profile cookies & storage (OS Keychain)
cases.title: The other system returns an error
cases.question: Is the message specific, and is there a retry or another route?
cases.expected: If Chrome holds a file lock on Default/Cookies, copy the WAL/DB snapshot or retry instead of failing cookie sync.

cases.step_name: Mirrors Chrome profile cookies & storage (OS Keychain)
cases.title: Half of it worked
cases.question: If only part succeeded, what state is the user left in and how do they finish?
cases.expected: If cookies copy succeeds but LocalStorage/IndexedDB fails, warn and re-auth cleanly rather than running half-authenticated.

cases.step_name: Spawns Chrome at (-3200,-3200) & runs agent workflow
cases.title: Connection drops while waiting
cases.question: Does the wait resume, restart or fail silently?
cases.expected: On network drop, save DOM checkpoint, release domain lease cleanly, and notify caller.

cases.step_name: Spawns Chrome at (-3200,-3200) & runs agent workflow
cases.title: The thing being waited for never arrives
cases.question: Is there a time limit and a next step when it runs out?
cases.expected: Enforce per-task max execution deadline distinct from heartbeat renewals so a hung page cannot renew leases forever.

cases.step_name: Releases SQLite lease & writes SHA-256 audit log
cases.title: No answer in time
cases.question: After how long does it give up, and what can the user do then?
cases.expected: Retry release with exponential backoff and verify owner token match before leaving a domain locked.

cases.step_name: Releases SQLite lease & writes SHA-256 audit log
cases.title: The other system returns an error
cases.question: Is the message specific, and is there a retry or another route?
cases.expected: Kill orphaned Chrome CDP PID if release fails, so zombie workers cannot keep mutating the domain after TTL expiry.

cases.step_name: Releases SQLite lease & writes SHA-256 audit log
cases.title: Half of it worked
cases.question: If only part succeeded, what state is the user left in and how do they finish?
cases.expected: Release SQLite lease and write SHA-256 audit row in one atomic transaction.

cases.step_name: Releases SQLite lease & writes SHA-256 audit log
cases.title: Data changed since the screen loaded
cases.question: If price, stock, permissions or status changed meanwhile, who wins?
cases.expected: If TTL expired while paused for human and another owner took the lease, reject release on token mismatch instead of deleting someone else's lock.

cases.step_name: Spawns Chrome at (-3200,-3200) & runs agent workflow
cases.title: Multi-monitor arrangement overlaps (-3200, -3200)
cases.question: What if a user has a 4K external monitor positioned top-left at negative coordinates, or macOS clamps the window back on-screen?
cases.expected: Query display bounds dynamically and place the viewport outside the union bounding box of all active monitors (or hide window level).

cases.step_name: Human finishes active tab & clicks Resume on pill
cases.title: Lease TTL (120s) expires while PAUSED_FOR_HUMAN
cases.question: If a human takes 3 minutes in Gmail while the agent is paused, does the stale lock scavenger expire the lease and discard the checkpoint?
cases.expected: Extend/hold paused leases with a distinct PAUSED state so another agent cannot steal the domain before human handoff finishes.

cases.step_name: Mirrors Chrome profile cookies & storage (OS Keychain)
cases.title: Data changed since the screen loaded
cases.question: If price, stock, permissions or status changed meanwhile, who wins?
cases.expected: If the human refreshes a session in visible Chrome while agent is queued, re-clone cookies after lease acquisition.
